Quick update from ops: we've traced the window to an autoscaling incident in a regional pool where cache warming stalled after a dependent infra upgrade. The incident elevated token compute latency (p95) substantially for ~3.5 hours; there were some timeouts at peak.

Root cause: a race in our cache-init path combined with a spike in cold-start requests. This is a systems bug; we have a patch ready for deployment (will ship 12/11 02:00 UTC) and a longer-term fix queued.

From an SLA perspective, p95 latency slipped beyond the committed threshold in that window — I would treat this as an SLA-impacting event for the affected region. Estimated scope: ~12% of Pulse traffic during the incident window based on their traces.

I'll attach the internal tracer slice and high-level RCA once the deploy confirms the fix.

-Jonas
